description.value: Vitasave is an independently owned Canadian health supplement and natural wellness retailer that has been operating since 2010, now serving over a million customers across two Vancouver storefronts. The Robson Street location stocks 3,000+ vitamins, supplements, protein products, and grocery superfoods — all NPN-certified and third-party tested — and also offers a smoothie menu. For cyclists seeking to restock on nutritional or health-focused supplies mid-tour, it is one of the more comprehensive natural health shops on central Vancouver's main retail corridor.
